items.prompt: lower_bound returns len(values). What does that mean under this sorted-input contract?

options.text: The target was found at a valid final index
options.why: len(values) is one past the last valid index.

options.text: Every value is less than the target
The sequence must contain a duplicate target
options.why: That does not follow from the insertion position.

options.text: It is safe to read values[len(values)]
options.why: That would be out of bounds.

items.explanation: An insertion position can be one past the sequence. Membership must check bounds before reading the element.
